summary: Zed là trình soạn thảo code cao tốc, đa người dùng, do tác giả Atom và Tree-sitter tạo ra, prioritize tốc độ và collaboration.
usecases: Collaborative real-time code editing for distributed teams
Fast editing and navigation in large codebases with minimal latency
Extensible plugin ecosystem for custom developer workflows
ideas: Integrate GPUI visualizations directly into editor workflows
Build a distributed pair-programming platform leveraging Zed's multiplayer core
Create theme syncing between editor UI and ambient system status
